mapper.select: SELECT id,task_type,article_id,task_status,request_id,target_index_name,total_count, success_count,failed_count,last_error FROM ai_index_task WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id,task_type,article_id,task_status,request_id,target_index_name,total_count, success_count,failed_count,last_error FROM ai_index_task WHERE task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND deleted=0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_index_task SET task_status='RUNNING',target_index_name=#{targetIndexName}, started_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0

UPDATE ai_index_task SET task_status='SUCCESS',total_count=#{totalCount}, success_count=#{successCount},failed_count=0,finished_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0

UPDATE ai_index_task SET task_status='FAILED',total_count=#{totalCount}, success_count=#{successCount},failed_count=GREATEST(#{totalCount}-#{successCount},1), finished_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=#{lastError},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
